headline: Margins and profit surge as Paycor integration costs ease
summary_short: Paychex's fiscal fourth-quarter revenue rose 12.5% y/y to $1.61B (down 11.2% q/q on normal seasonality), while operating income jumped 40.3% y/y to $604.7M and diluted EPS grew 42.7% y/y to $1.17, as Paycor acquisition-related integration costs eased.
summary_long: Revenue grew 12.5% y/y to $1.61B (Management Solutions +14%, aided ~8pts by Paycor; PEO/Insurance +9%) but fell 11.2% q/q on normal fiscal-Q3 seasonality rolling off. Operating income rose 40.3% y/y to $604.7M as operating margin expanded to 37.7% from 30.2%, mainly on lower Paycor acquisition-related costs. Net income was $420.6M (+41.5% y/y); diluted EPS $1.17 (+42.7% y/y); adjusted diluted EPS $1.32 (+11% y/y). Fiscal-2026 operating cash flow was $2.6B; Paychex returned $2.2B to shareholders via $1.6B dividends and $611M buybacks. For fiscal 2027, guidance calls for total revenue growth of 5-6%, adjusted operating margin near 44%, and adjusted diluted EPS growth of 7-9%.
